## Description / 变更说明

[EN] Please provide a summary of your changes, including the problem solved or the ruleset added.
[ZH] 请简要说明本次 Pull Request 的修改内容、解决的问题或新增的规则库。

---

## Type of Change / 变更类型

- [ ] 🛡️ **Ruleset Submission / 规则库贡献** (`rules/*.yaml`)
- [ ] 🐛 **Bug Fix / 缺陷修复**
- [ ] ✨ **New Feature / 新功能**
- [ ] 🧹 **Chore & Refactoring / 整理与重构**

---

## Pre-Submission Checklist / 提交前检查清单

- [ ] [EN] My branch stems from `dev` and follows naming conventions (`feature/*`, `bugfix/*`, `chore/*`, `ruleset/*`).
  [ZH] 我的分支从 `dev` 切出，并遵循命名规范 (`feature/*`, `bugfix/*`, `chore/*`, `ruleset/*`)。
- [ ] [EN] I have executed `./gradlew app:testDebugUnitTest` and all unit tests pass.
  [ZH] 我已运行 `./gradlew app:testDebugUnitTest` 并确认所有单元测试通过。
- [ ] [EN] If AI / Agent coding was used, I have thoroughly inspected and tested the code locally before submission.
  [ZH] 若使用了 AI 编程助手，提交前我已完整检查并进行过本地测试验证。
- [ ] [EN] I confirm that this submission complies with the project's Code of Conduct (No racism, no politics, pure focus on cybersecurity).
  [ZH] 我确认本次提交符合项目行为准则（无种族主义、无政治内容，纯粹专注于网络安全防御）。
